WITH DimAccount AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.DimAccount 
    WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP', 'LNS', 'CCD', 'TRU', 'TRY')
)

SELECT
DimCustomer.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,DimCustomer.CustomerName AS CustomerName
,DimPartY.PartyID AS GlobalCIF
,DimCustomer.CustomerType AS CustomerType
,DimCustomer.DateOfBirth AS Birthdate
,DimCustomer.MaritalStatus AS MaritalStatus
,DimCustomer.Gender AS Gender
,DimCustomer.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
,DimCustomer.Email AS EmailAddress
,DimCustomer.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
,DimCustomer.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,DimCustomer.City AS City
,DimCustomer.Province AS Province
,DimCustomer.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,DimCustomer.Country AS Country
,DimCustomer.EmployerName AS EmployerName
,DimCustomer.OfficeAddressLine1 AS OfficeAddressLine1
,DimCustomer.OfficeAddressLine2 AS OfficeAddressLine2
,DimCustomer.OfficeCity AS OfficeCity
,DimCustomer.OfficeProvince ASOfficeProvince
,DimCustomer.OfficeZipCode AS OfficeZipCode
,DimCustomer.Country AS Country
,DimCustomer.Industry AS Industry
,DimCustomerEmployment.Occupation AS Occupation

DDA.AccountOpenedDate AS Tenure
FactTotalRelationshipBalance.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull AS 
FactTotalRelationshipBalance.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated AS 
FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDPFull AS 
FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated AS 
FROM DimAccount DDA

SELECT
FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment.OutstandingInvestmentFull AS 
FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment.OutstandingInvestmentProrated AS 
DimCustomer.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
DimCustomer.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
DimCustomer.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
DimCustomer.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
DimCustomer.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
DimCustomer.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
DimCustomer.ATMEnrollmentIndicator AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
DimCustomer.MBKEnrollmentIndicator AS MBKEnrollmentIndicator
DimCustomer.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS RIB/BOBEnrollmentIndicator
DimAccount.PayrollIndicator AS PayrollIndicator
DimAccount.PayrollIndicator AS PayrollIndicator
DimCustomer.GenerationalCohort AS GenerationalCohort
DimMarketSegment.MarketSegmentName AS MarketSegment
LastUpdatedDate



FROM DW.DimMarketSegment DDMS
